head.t: ITH Pharma and Baxter top South East's £8.6m dose-banded chemotherapy framework
head.x: Berkshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust has awarded a ranked framework for dose-banded and patient-specific chemotherapy products on behalf of the South East Pharmacy Procurement Service, open to up to 26 trusts across Kent, Surrey, Sussex, Hampshire, Oxfordshire and the Thames Valley.

head.t: Framework ending 31 July 2027: Extension Sets and Lines
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Baxter Healthcare Limited". 23 suppliers on the framework.

head.t: Framework ending 19 July 2027: Infusion Pumps and Administration Sets and Associated Products
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Baxter Healthcare Ltd". 27 suppliers on the framework.
